name: pyArchInit US Table
description: Mapping for pyArchInit us_table -> Extended Matrix graph. Tier 1: identity via entity_uuid passthrough (#14), spatial via LocationNodeGroup (#24), and intrinsic qualia typed -> CIDOC (E54 Dimension / E55 Type / E57 Material) through em_qualia_types.json. Tier 2 (this version): periodo/fase -> EpochNode via has_first_epoch / survive_in_epoch (resolved against periodizzazione_table by epoch_mappings), documentazione/doc_usv -> DocumentNode via has_documentation, schedatore/direttore_us/responsabile_us -> AuthorNode via has_author. Remaining deferred columns are in _tier2_pending_handlers (issue #26).

table_settings._comment_template: Human-readable label, unique WITHIN a site: location (area.settore, dot-separated) + type+number attached (USM1). Site is NOT in the GraphML label (added only in the 3D scene for multi-site). Stable identity is the UUID (entity_uuid -> node_id), not the name. Empty components collapse (1..US1 -> 1.US1).

unita_tipo._comment: Drives the StratigraphicNode subclass (US/USM/USV...) and is a name component.

entity_uuid._comment: Tier-1 identity: value becomes node_id (== EMid, UUID v7) for idempotent re-import. Live demo DB + US_table.py use 'entity_uuid'; Enzo's graph_ingestor queries 'node_uuid' -> reconcile to ONE column name (see #25/#26).

attivita._comment: Tier-1 keeps the legacy PropertyNode behaviour; ActivityNodeGroup (is_in_activity) is a Tier-2 option.

schedatore._comment: Tier-2: person -> shared AuthorNode (deduped by name), has_author edge. Role kept as provenance only.

documentazione._comment: Tier-2: pyArchInit presence checklist [[label,'Si'],...]; each affirmative entry -> one per-US DocumentNode (has_documentation). All pyArchInit checklist types (Fotografie/Planimetrie/Sezioni/Diapositive/Fotopiano) are 2D.

doc_usv._comment: Tier-2: single file reference -> shared DocumentNode deduped by path, path stored as url.

epoch_mappings._comment: Initial period/phase -> the epoch in which the US first appears. EpochNode needs a concrete time span, absent from us_table, so resolve the code against periodizzazione_table.
Final period/phase -> the latest epoch the US survives into. Rows without a final period are skipped (no edge).

_tier2_done._comment: Landed in v1.6.2 -- handlers mirror _process_location_memberships. See issue #26.
_tier2_done.periodo_iniziale / fase_iniziale / perio: EpochNode via epoch_mappings (has_first_epoch / survive_in_epoch), span resolved through the periodizzazione_table join.
_tier2_done.documentazione / doc_usv: DocumentNode via has_documentation (checklist -> per-US docs; file path -> shared doc).

_tier2_pending_handlers._comment: Still NOT mapped -- need new importer handlers / disambiguation. See issue #26.
_tier2_pending_handlers.n_catalogo_generale / n_catalogo_interno: Catalogue identifiers (empty on the demo DB). Closer to inventory ids than documents -- defer until the modelling is decided (DocumentNode vs. a dedicated identifier qualia).
_tier2_pending_handlers.quota_* (quota_min_usm / quota_max_usm /: Spatial qualia (Elevation / Absolute Position). Deferred: multiple quote collide on the single-PropertyNode-per-property_name id rule (needs disambiguated ids).
